title: Coarse manual grater
text: Coarse manual grater. Very nice manual coarse grater - comes with a nice plastic cover for storing.  Easy to hold, easy to use, easy to clean.  Win/win/win. Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
